content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler Juice, NFS is a 100 % natural fruit juice specially formulated for children from 1 year old. It is made from selected apples, pears and carrots, without added sugar, preservatives or artificial flavors. The product undergoes strict quality control and meets infant nutrition standards.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The juice is produced from fruits grown without pesticides.
Each bottle contains exactly 150 ml, an optimal portion for toddler feeding.
It provides vitamin C, which supports the child’s immune system.
No added sugar – sweetness comes from the natural sugars of the fruits.
The packaging is made from recyclable PET, reducing environmental impact.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C helps strengthen the immune system and improves iron absorption.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Pectin from apples and pears aids regular bowel movements.

items.title: Source of beta‑carotene
items.content: Carrots provide provitamin A, essential for vision and growth.

items.title: Low sodium content
items.content: The juice is suitable for children who need to limit salt intake.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: Helps maintain fluid balance, especially in warm weather.

items.title: Fruit allergy
items.content: Children with known allergies to apples, pears or carrots should avoid this product.

items.title: Not for infants under 1 year
items.content: The juice may be too heavy for the digestive system of babies younger than one year.

items.title: Natural sugar content
items.content: Although no sugar is added, the product still contains fructose; moderate consumption is advised.

items.title: Post‑opening storage
items.content: After opening, the juice should be consumed within 24 hours to prevent fermentation.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the juice chilled or at room temperature. Offer small portions (30–50 ml) several times a day, combined with other toddler foods.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within one day.
